request: Retire the four standalone cloud, supply chain, transport identity, and compliance workbenches and consolidate their offline assessment workflows into two packages.
scope: Migrate package discovery, portable exports, repository assessment and reporting, specialist routing, the default auditor handoff, and operator documentation. Keep sibling workbenches independently installable.
setup: Use baseline commit 53eedc24b4e02aa47c114f9113c77431ac7ba2ad for the prior packages. Record marketplace pins and checksum the baseline exports. Install the project Python dependencies and use temporary directories for exports and clean client installations.
constraints: Keep the four skill IDs, specialist IDs, capability selectors, and v1 evidence formats. Validate supplied offline artifacts with no target contact. Defer authenticated model-driven invocation to release validation after source merge. Release both replacements and withdraw the retired marketplace entries in the same release after the native client checks in docs/EXPANSION_MIGRATION.md pass.

steps.action: Build portable exports of the retired packages, verify the rollback archive by restoring it into a temporary directory, and record the four baseline demos.

verify.command: In a detached baseline checkout, run python3 scripts/agent/export_portable.py --output <new-directory>, then python3 -m cops demo <retired-package> for each migration row.
verify.expected: All four demos pass and the restored packages reproduce the archived bytes.

steps.action: Move the four skills into the two replacement packages and use the shared artifact assessment and report runtime for both repository and portable invocation.

verify.expected: The repository produces a v1 report and all exported playbacks verify their declared results in isolation.

steps.action: Move package registrations, regenerate marketplace indexes, update specialist package pointers, and direct retired package lookups to their replacements.

verify.expected: The candidate has 23 packages with no retired IDs in marketplace discovery. Each retired info request exits 2 and identifies its replacement selector.

steps.action: Resolve the registered auditor's saved skill reference to the replacement package and bind acceptance to the existing plan and exact skill bytes.

verify.expected: The recorded proposal is restored and accepted by the default auditor with a matching workflow target checksum and fixture evidence digest.

steps.action: Run the repository checks and the baseline parity comparison. Apply the native client migration and rollback steps in the operator guide, then follow the documented seven-day observation procedure after publication.

verify.expected: Repository checks pass. The separate parity comparison matches baseline results and errors and shows optional cryptography availability. The native client checks confirm each retained skill appears once after migration.

acceptance.entrypoint: scripts/agent/export_portable.py and each exported package's declared playbacks
acceptance.given: The candidate catalog includes the two replacements and both sibling workbenches.
acceptance.when: Export packages and run the published playback commands with an isolated runtime outside the source packages.
acceptance.then: The replacement demos verify all four correction families and the sibling packages still pass their own demos.

acceptance.given: The canonical package catalog and specialist registry use the two replacement IDs.
acceptance.when: Build and audit the capability matrix.
acceptance.then: The matrix accounts for 23 packages, 27 specialists, 37 scenarios, and 87 capability records with a passing audit.

acceptance.given: A scoped cloud configuration artifact and explicit report provenance.
acceptance.when: Call the repository report command with the cloud_configuration selector.
acceptance.then: The result uses the existing v1 assessment-report envelope and retains the expected scope and provenance.

acceptance.given: A client looks up one of the four retired package IDs.
acceptance.when: Request package information using the retired ID.
acceptance.then: The command exits 2 and names the replacement and capability selector in the error.

acceptance.entrypoint: Default triad auditor and specialist handoff acceptance
acceptance.given: A saved proposal names the compliance auditor and the stable compliance skill ID.
acceptance.when: Restore the proposal and accept it against the candidate catalog.
acceptance.then: The proposal binds to the governance evidence skill and matching plan while the offline fixture evidence retains its digest.

acceptance.given: A proposal lacks a workflow target implementation.
acceptance.when: Ask the recipient to accept the proposal.
acceptance.then: Acceptance fails before a workflow can start.
